title: Thermistor Fault
fullDescription: F1 on Electrolux microwaves indicates the cavity thermistor has failed. Microwave disables cooking.

title: Keypad Fault
fullDescription: F2 indicates a stuck key. Clean or replace the keypad.

title: Humidity Sensor Error
fullDescription: F3 indicates the humidity sensor is not working. Manual cook should still function.

title: Shorted Thermistor
fullDescription: F4 indicates shorted thermistor. Replace sensor.

title: Door Interlock Error
fullDescription: F5 indicates the door interlock switches are not in sync, which is a safety fault.

title: Line Voltage Error
fullDescription: F6 reports voltage supply issues. Check outlet voltage.

title: Board Communication Error
fullDescription: F7 is a board communication error. Reset first, replace board if persists.

title: Cooling Fan Error
fullDescription: F8 indicates cooling fan failure. Overheating risk for magnetron.

title: Turntable Motor Error
fullDescription: F9 indicates turntable motor failure. Food will heat unevenly.

title: Magnetron Thermal Fault
fullDescription: F10 is a magnetron overheat fault. Unit must cool before restart. Check vents.

faq.a: Often cheaper if unit is old.
